title: GLG Signs 77,382 SF Lease Renewal at One Grand Central Place
summary: GLG renewed its headquarters lease at One Grand Central Place in Midtown Manhattan with Empire State Realty Trust. CEO Gemma Postlethwaite cited the location's unmatched environment for convening experts and clients as a key factor in the long-term commitment.
whyItMatters: Major lease renewal signals long-term commitment to NYC headquarters presence.
